title: Jobs running at a provider
description: A magnet handed to a provider account is fetched there rather than here, and arrives as addresses once it is done. It keeps running while this machine does not, and the account keeps it afterwards until somebody deletes it.
empty: No job is running at a provider.

submit.description: The provider fetches it and hands the finished addresses to the LinkGrabber. The same magnet twice is one job, not two.
submit.started: The provider was given the job.
submit.already_running: This account is already running a job for that content. Nothing was sent a second time.
submit.file_too_large: The file exceeds the {max_mib} MiB a remote job may carry

choice.title: Choose what you want
choice.description: The provider fetches only what is picked here, and nothing moves until it is answered.

discard.confirm_title: Delete this job at the provider?
discard.confirm_description: This deletes the job inside your provider account. It happens outside this machine and cannot be undone. The entry stays in this list afterwards and records that it was deleted.
discard.done: The job was deleted at the provider.

forget.confirm_title: Remove this entry from the list?
forget.confirm_description: This removes the entry here and nothing else. Whatever the provider holds stays in your account, untouched.
forget.done: The entry was removed. Nothing was deleted at the provider.

page.title: Remote jobs
page.description: Magnets handed to a provider account run there, not here. Follow them, answer the questions they stop for, and end them — at the provider or only in this list.

no_remote_job_accounts: None of your accounts belong to a service with an installed remote-job plugin. Install one, or add an account with a service that has one.
accounts_unavailable: The list of services that can take a job could not be read.
accounts_loading: Reading which of your accounts can take a job…

files.drop_hint: Several .torrent or .nzb files can be chosen at once or dropped here – each becomes a job of its own, handed over one after another.
files.wrong_type: Only .torrent and .nzb files can be handed over
files.unreadable: The file could not be read
files.summary_failed: {failed} of {total} files could not be handed over; each says why. The others went ahead.

package.downloads: The package has left the LinkGrabber – go to the download list

local.confirm_description: {count} job at {providers} is removed from this list. Whatever the provider holds stays untouched in your account. | {count} jobs at {providers} are removed from this list. Whatever the providers hold stays untouched in your accounts.

provider.action: Discard at the provider and clear ({count})
provider.confirm_title: Discard at the provider and clear the list?
provider.confirm_description: {count} job is deleted in your account at {providers}, if it still exists there, and then removed from this list. This happens outside this machine and cannot be undone. If the provider cannot delete it, it stays in the list and says why. | {count} jobs are deleted in your accounts at {providers}, if they still exist there, and then removed from this list. This happens outside this machine and cannot be undone. A job its provider cannot delete stays in the list and says why.
provider.confirm_label: Delete at the provider and clear

clear.running_left: {count} job is still running and stays. | {count} jobs are still running and stay.
clear.partial: {removed} removed; {failed} job stayed because its provider could not delete it. | {removed} removed; {failed} jobs stayed because their provider could not delete them.
